emailSettings.title: Email Settings
emailSettings.subtitle: The SMTP server used to email notifications, the sender details, and which notifications are sent by email.
emailSettings.enabledHint: When off, notifications only appear in the app and no email is sent.
emailSettings.disabledNote: Email sending is currently off. Enter the server details, try them with a test email, then turn sending on and save.
emailSettings.presetHint: Fills in the server, port and security; you enter the username and password.
emailSettings.passwordSaved: A password is saved; enter a new one to change it
emailSettings.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown on this screen again.
emailSettings.clearPassword: Delete the saved password (server without authentication)
emailSettings.fromNameHint: Shown in the recipient's inbox and at the top of the email template.
emailSettings.replyToHint: Where replies go; the sender address is used if empty.
emailSettings.typesHint: Notifications you turn off still appear in the app. Users can turn off their own emails on the Profile screen.
emailSettings.saveError: Email settings could not be saved.
emailSettings.loadError: Email settings could not be loaded.
emailSettings.testHint: Sends a single email with the settings in the form (without saving); works even while sending is off.
emailSettings.logHint: Per-recipient status of notification emails. Failed sends are retried automatically after 1 and 5 minutes.
emailSettings.logEmpty: No email records match this filter.
